title: Beat
description: A single beat within a scene. The finest-grained structural unit. Beats have a typed function, a word count target, and optionally a speaker (for dialogue beats). Payoff/setup chains are tracked here.

beat_type.description: Functional type of this beat. Universal values: action, dialogue, interiority, description, transition, revelation, confrontation, intimate_escalation. Genre modules may extend.

word_count_target.description: Target word count for this beat.

speaker_character_id.description: For dialogue beats: which character is speaking. Null for non-dialogue beats.

pov_character_id.description: POV character for this beat if it differs from the scene default.

intensity.description: Emotional/tension intensity of this beat (0.0 = flat, 1.0 = peak). Used by scene rhythm ledger.

setup_for.description: Beat ID this beat sets up (Chekhov linkage). Stub — expand during Phase 7 implementation.

payoff_of.description: Beat ID this beat pays off (Chekhov linkage). Stub — expand during Phase 7 implementation.

expected_reader_response.description: Intended reader emotional response. Used by Reader agent for evaluation. Stub — expand during Phase 8 implementation.
